aboutMe.text: Backend-focused Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience specializing in the MERN stack and sensor-integrated web applications. Proven track record of independently architecting and delivering production-ready systems including real-time fleet tracking platforms, telemetry backend infrastructure, and enterprise management dashboards. Experienced in building scalable APIs serving 1000+ daily transactions, implementing comprehensive testing with 100% coverage, and optimizing web performance. Passionate about creating efficient, well-documented solutions that drive business value.
